note:
条件 = a stipulated requirement/term (contract, agreement).
状態 = the state something is in (situation, physical).
状況 = the situation / circumstances — how things stand around an event, often changing (状況が変わる).
調子 = form/condition — health, mood, how something performs.
具合 = condition/state, often health or how things are going.

終わり = the end (noun, general).
終わる = to end (verb).
末 = the close of a period (end of the week/month/year).
果てる = to come to an end / be exhausted — dramatic, e.g. life's end.

気持ち = feeling/sensation, emotional or physical.
気分 = mood — how you feel right now.
感じ = impression/sense — the feel of something.
心持ち = state of mind; also 'a touch/slightly' (literary).

計画 = a concrete plan/project.
企画 = a planned proposal/project (business, events).
予定 = a schedule — what's set to happen.
策 = a measure/scheme/tactic.

現実 = reality (vs ideal/dream).
真実 = the truth (the facts).
本当 = the real thing / 'really' (everyday).
実在 = actual existence — that something really exists.

体 = body (everyday).
身体 = body (more formal, physical-health context).
身 = one's person/self/flesh — oneself.

父 = (my) father — plain, your own.
父親 = father as the role (neutral).
お父さん = dad — polite/address, affectionate.

母 = (my) mother — plain.
母親 = mother as the role (neutral).
お母さん = mom — polite/address.

私 = I — neutral, polite, any gender.
僕 = I — soft, masculine, casual-polite.
俺 = I — rough, masculine, casual/intimate.

最初 = the first/beginning in sequence or time.
一番 = number one / the most (ranking).
第一 = first/foremost (formal: 'firstly, primarily').

女の子 = girl (everyday).
女子 = female/girls as a category (girls' school, sports).
少女 = a young girl (literary, ~adolescent).

中 = inside/middle (general).
内 = within (abstract — within a group/period).
内側 = the inner side/inside surface.

王 = king (general/abstract).
王様 = king — familiar/storybook (with 様).
国王 = the king of a nation (formal title).

番号 = an assigned number (phone, ID).
号 = number/issue (magazine issue; unit suffix).
数 = number/quantity — how many.

過ぎる = to pass by / exceed (go past; time passes).
経つ = (time) elapses.
通る = to pass through / go along a route.

横 = the side — lateral, beside.
側 = one of two sides; 'by one's side'.
辺 = the vicinity/area around (this area).

旅行 = a trip/travel (general).
旅 = a journey — literary, longer, romantic.
遠足 = an excursion/field trip (school outing).

赤ちゃん = baby (everyday, affectionate).
赤ん坊 = baby/infant — slightly more formal/literary.

生まれる = to be born (general; also figurative 'come into being').
産まれる = to be born — the physical act of birth, emphasizes the delivery.

上る = to go up / ascend (stairs, a slope, the sun rising).
登る = to climb actively (mountains, trees).

雰囲気 = atmosphere/mood of a place or situation.
大気 = the atmosphere — the physical air around the earth.

足す = to add (numbers; add more of something).
加える = to add/include/apply (an element, force, heat) — more formal/abstract.

全部 = all / the whole — everyday, a countable whole.
全て = all/everything — slightly more formal/written.

欠席 = absence from a meeting/class — not attending.
留守 = absence from home — being out, no one home.

記念日 = a commemorative day you mark (the date).
周年 = the -th anniversary as a counter ('10周年' = 10th anniversary).

自動 = automatic/self-acting — noun-like (自動ドア = automatic door).
自動的 = automatic as a な-adjective/adverb ('automatically').

増える = to increase — intransitive, numbers grow.
増す = to increase/grow — intransitive or transitive, more literary.
増加 = increase as a noun (formal/statistical).

応援 = support/cheering — encouragement, rooting for someone.
支援 = support/aid — material or organizational assistance.

兵士 = a soldier (individual serviceman).
軍人 = a military person — career military, any rank.
兵 = soldier/troops (general; also a counter).

受け取る = to receive/accept — physically take delivery.
貰う = to receive/get — be given (casual).
受ける = to receive/undergo — take an exam, receive an action.

変える = to change something (general).
改める = to revise/reform/correct — formally amend rules, attitude, behaviour.

市 = a city as an administrative unit ('-shi').
都市 = a city as an urban area/concept (a big city).

子供 = child (everyday).
子 = child/offspring — one's own child; also 'the young of'.

男の子 = boy (everyday).
少年 = a boy/youth — formal, legal/literary (~juvenile).

上司 = one's superior at work (boss).
親分 = boss of a gang/group — a yakuza or gang leader.

彼 = he/him; also 'boyfriend' from context.
彼氏 = boyfriend explicitly.

忙しい = busy — everyday adjective.
多忙 = very busy — formal/written (な-adj / noun 'busyness').

平気 = unconcerned / fine / 'no problem' — not bothered.
平静 = calm/composure — formal emotional steadiness.

地区 = a district/zone — a designated area.
辺り = the area around / vicinity — vague 'around here'.

早速 = right away/promptly — taking quick action on something.
今すぐ = right now/immediately — this very instant.

実際 = in actual fact / actually (reality vs what was expected).
現に = actually / as concrete proof — 'as a matter of fact, right now'.

角 = an angle / a corner.
角度 = angle as a measured degree.

答え = an answer (noun).
答える = to answer (verb).
回答 = a formal reply/response (a survey, an official answer).

品 = an article/item/goods (a product).
記事 = an article — a piece of writing (news, magazine).

想定 = an assumption / anticipated scenario you plan around.
仮定 = a hypothesis/supposition — 'if we assume…'.

悪い = bad (general).
不良 = defective / delinquent — poor quality or bad behaviour (不良品, 不良少年).

境 = a boundary/border between things (everyday).
境界 = a boundary / demarcation line (formal, precise).

支店 = a branch (of a shop or bank).
支局 = a branch bureau (news agency, post office).

坊さん = a monk (polite, お坊さん).
坊主 = a monk; also 'shaved head' or 'kid' — casual, can be blunt/rude.

バス停 = a bus stop.
乗り場 = a boarding point (taxi rank, platform, bus bay).

運ぶ = to carry / transport (move from A to B).
担ぐ = to carry on the shoulder; also 'to play a trick on / dupe'.

変化 = change/transformation — something changes form/state.
交代 = changing over / taking turns (a shift, a relief, swapping).

服 = clothes (everyday).
衣 = garment/robe — literary, and in compounds (衣服, 衣類).

布 = cloth/fabric (a piece of cloth).
布地 = dress material / fabric (cloth as material for making things).

来る = to come (plain).
参る = to come/go — humble (謙譲語), polite self-lowering.

取れる = to come off / come loose (a button, a handle).
外れる = to come off / slip out of place; also 'to miss' (a guess, the mark).

お笑い = comedy / stand-up (TV comedy, comedians).
喜劇 = comedy as a genre — a comedic play.

競う = to compete / vie (a race, a contest — friendly rivalry).
争う = to fight / dispute / contend (a struggle, a quarrel, a lawsuit).

完成 = completion of making something (a building, a work is finished).
完了 = completion of a process/task (a procedure is done).

建設 = construction / building (large-scale; also founding, nation-building).
工事 = construction work / roadworks — the actual works in progress.

協力 = cooperation — helping together toward a goal.
共同 = joint / shared — done jointly (共同作業, joint venture).

批判 = criticism — a reasoned critique/evaluation.
非難 = blame / condemnation — harsh, accusatory.

批判する = to critique / appraise critically.
非難する = to blame / condemn / denounce.

大勢 = a large number of people / a crowd (many people).
集団 = a group / collective — an organised body.

夜明け = daybreak / dawn (noun).
明ける = (night/year) to dawn / break / end (verb).

決める = to decide / choose (personal, everyday).
決定する = to determine / finalise (formal, an official decision).

下りる = to get down / descend (stairs, get off a vehicle).
下る = to go down (a slope, a river; a verdict 'comes down').

細かい = fine / minute / small (tiny details; also fussy).
詳しい = detailed / thorough; also 'well-informed about'.

方言 = a dialect (the concept).
〜弁 = '-ben', the speech of a specific region (関西弁 = Kansai dialect).

辞書 = a dictionary (everyday).
辞典 = a dictionary / lexicon — formal, often specialised (百科辞典).

死ぬ = to die (plain, direct).
果てる = to perish / meet one's end — literary, dramatic.

方向 = direction — which way something faces/goes.
方 = direction / side; also a polite word for 'person'.

嫌悪 = disgust / aversion (the dislike itself).
嫌悪感 = a feeling of disgust — the 感 marks it as the sensation.

嫌い = dislike (な-adjective: 'I dislike X').
嫌 = unpleasant / don't want it — reluctance, 'ugh, no'.

区 = a ward — an administrative subdivision (渋谷区).
地区 = a district / area — a designated zone.

地区 = a district / area (general).
区域 = a zone / demarcated area — a bounded section (formal).

分ける = to divide / separate / share out.
割る = to split / break / divide (maths, crack in two).

区分 = a division / classification (partitioning into sections).
割り算 = division — the arithmetic operation.

医者 = a doctor (everyday).
医師 = a physician — the formal professional title.

二倍 = double / twice the amount.
二重 = double / twofold — two layers (二重まぶた, double-check).

役目 = one's duty / role — what you're responsible for.
任務 = a mission / assignment — an official task given to you.

各々 = each one (individually, 'each and every').
各〜 = each- (prefix: 各国 each country).

地球 = the Earth — the planet.
地 = ground / land / earth — the surface/soil.

電気 = electricity / an electric light (everyday — 電気を消す).
電力 = electric power — as a resource (power supply, utilities).

入り口 = an entrance / doorway (the opening).
入場 = entry / admission — the act of entering a venue.

不可欠 = indispensable / essential — cannot do without it.
重要 = important / significant.

毎日 = every day — routinely.
連日 = day after day — consecutive days, often emphasising a run of them.

皆さん = everyone (polite).
皆様 = everyone — very polite / honorific (formal address).

存在 = existence / presence — that something exists.
生存 = survival / being alive — the existence of life.

出口 = an exit (noun).
出る = to exit / go out / leave (verb).

期待 = expectation — hopeful anticipation (looking forward to).
想定 = an assumption — an anticipated scenario you plan for.

経験 = experience — accumulated over time (general).
体験 = a first-hand experience — a specific event you go through.

説明 = an explanation (general — making something clear).
解説 = commentary / exposition — detailed, expert (a 解説者 commentator).

表情 = facial expression — the changing look on a face.
顔付き = facial features / the cast of one's face — its set appearance.

疲れ = tiredness (everyday).
疲労 = fatigue — formal, physical/medical (疲労が溜まる).

火 = fire — a flame.
火事 = a fire — a destructive blaze (a house fire).

床 = the floor — the surface you stand on.
〜階 = -th floor — a storey of a building (3階).

林 = a wood / grove — smaller, often planted.
森 = a forest — larger and denser.

友達 = friend (everyday).
友人 = friend — formal / written.

毛 = hair / fur — on a body.
毛皮 = fur / pelt — the material (a fur coat).

産む = to give birth — to physically bear a child.
生む = to give birth; also figurative 'to produce / create' (生む利益).

下りる = to come/get down — descend, get off.
下がる = to go down / drop — price, temperature; also 'step back'.

神 = god / deity (the concept).
神様 = god — with honorific 様, reverent or familiar.

得意 = good at / one's forte — confident speciality.
上手い = skillful / well-executed; also 'tasty' (food).

政府 = the government — the governing body/institution.
政治 = politics / governance — the activity itself.

半分 = a half — one of two parts.
半 = half- (prefix/suffix: 半額 half price, 3時半 half past three).

幸せ = happiness — felt, personal.
幸い = fortunate / a blessing — formal; also 'fortunately'.

苦労 = hardship / toil — personal struggle and effort.
困難 = difficulty / adversity — formal, an obstacle.

頭 = head (everyday).
頭部 = the head region — anatomical / clinical.

高さ = height — how tall/high something is.
丈 = length / stature — of clothing or a person's height (背丈).

助ける = to help / save / rescue — aid, especially from danger.
手伝う = to help / assist — lend a hand with a task.

打つ = to hit / strike (a blow, a ball, a key).
放つ = to release / shoot / emit — let fly, give off.

正直 = honest / truthful — doesn't lie.
素直 = honest / frank / obedient — open, docile, takes things as they are.

家 = house / home.
〜宅 = residence (-taku) — お宅 = your home/household (polite).

無理 = impossible / unreasonable — 'can't manage it', 'no way' (everyday).
不可能 = impossible — formally not possible.

産業 = industry — sectors of the economy broadly.
工業 = (manufacturing) industry — factories, engineering.

判断 = judgment / decision — assessing and deciding.
審判 = a refereeing / judgment — an umpire's call; also divine judgment.

知る = to know / come to know (plain).
存じる = to know — humble (存じております).

知識 = knowledge — information you possess.
心得 = know-how / the basics one should know — guidelines, rudiments.

去年 = last year (everyday).
昨年 = last year — formal / written.

笑う = to laugh (verb).
笑い = laughter / a laugh (noun).

去る = to leave / depart — move away from (also 'the past 〜').
立ち去る = to walk away / leave the spot — get up and go.

伝説 = a legend — folklore, a legendary tale or figure.
物語 = a story / tale — a narrative.

文字 = a letter / character — of writing.
手紙 = a letter — correspondence you mail.

生活 = life / living — daily life, lifestyle.
命 = life — the life force you can lose.

光 = light — rays, shining, illumination.
明かり = a light / lamp — a source that lights up a space.

線 = a line — a drawn line, a train line.
列 = a line / row / queue — people or things in a row.

住む = to live / reside — dwell somewhere.
生きる = to live / be alive — have life.

負ける = to lose — a match, or give in.
失う = to lose — be deprived of something (a thing, a person).

敗者 = the loser / the defeated — formal.
負け犬 = a 'loser' / underdog — derogatory, slangy.

愛 = love (noun).
愛する = to love (verb, weighty/romantic).
大好き = love it / really like — everyday, lighter (also for things).

恋人 = a sweetheart / partner — boyfriend or girlfriend.
愛人 = a lover / mistress — illicit, an affair.

機械 = a machine (general).
機 = machine / -craft (suffix: 飛行機 aeroplane); also 'opportunity/chance'.

男 = man / male — plain, can be blunt.
男の人 = a man — polite ('a male person').

試合 = a match / game — sports.
勝負 = a contest of win-or-lose — a showdown, a bout, 'game on'.

資料 = materials / data — documents, reference material.
生地 = cloth or dough — fabric / raw material.

算数 = arithmetic — elementary-school maths.
数学 = mathematics — the discipline.

会議 = a meeting / conference — formal.
会 = a gathering / society / 'meet' — an association or get-together.

覚える = to learn / memorize / remember — commit to memory (broad).
暗記する = to memorize by heart — rote, verbatim.

述べる = to state / express — set forth an opinion (formal).
口にする = to mention / say out loud; also 'to eat'.

方法 = a method / way — how to do something.
仕方 = the way / manner of doing — also 仕方ない 'it can't be helped'.

気分 = mood — how you yourself feel.
機嫌 = (someone's) humour / temper — 機嫌が良い 'in a good mood'.

登山 = mountaineering — formal, the activity/sport.
山登り = (going) mountain climbing — everyday.

動き = movement / motion — something moving.
運動 = exercise; also a movement/campaign (政治運動).

殺人 = murder — the crime/act (formal, 殺人事件).
人殺し = a killing / a murderer — blunt, can name the person.

名前 = name (everyday).
名 = name / fame — literary and in compounds (有名, 名を残す).

狭い = narrow / cramped — little space (a narrow room).
細い = thin / slender — small in width (a thin line, thin legs).

祝日 = a public holiday — a national day of celebration.
祭日 = a festival / holy day — older term, often used interchangeably with 祝日.

当然 = natural / as expected — 'of course, naturally'.
当たり前 = obvious / taken for granted — everyday, 'goes without saying'.

明らか = clear / evident — plain to see, demonstrable.
当然 = natural / only to be expected — 'obviously, of course'.

近所 = neighborhood — the area right around your home; where the neighbours are (近所の人).
付近 = vicinity — the area near a given point or landmark (駅の付近, この付近).
町内 = within the town/district — the local community block (町内会 = neighbourhood association).

正月 = New Year — the holiday period and its celebrations.
新年 = the new year — the year itself (新年おめでとう).

夜 = night (general).
晩 = evening / a particular night — 今晩 tonight, 晩ご飯 dinner.

数字 = a numeral / figure — the digits.
数詞 = a numeral — the grammatical term for number-words.

起こる = to happen / occur — an event takes place.
生じる = to arise / be produced — a problem or result emerges.

兄 = (my) older brother — plain, your own.
お兄さん = older brother — polite / address.

姉 = (my) older sister — plain.
お姉さん = older sister — polite / address.

次々 = one after another — in steady succession.
続々 = in rapid succession / in droves — many, pouring in.

自分 = oneself / myself (everyday).
自ら = oneself / personally — formal, 'of one's own accord'.

元 = origin / source / former — the base or root (元はと言えば).
由来 = origin / derivation — where a name or custom comes from.

元々 = originally / from the start — to begin with.
本来 = originally / properly — by rights, inherently (本来あるべき姿).

先日 = the other day — slightly formal.
この前 = the other day / last time — casual.

外 = outside (general).
外側 = the outer side / outside surface.

海外 = overseas / abroad (everyday).
在外 = (located) abroad — formal (在外日本人 Japanese living overseas).

平和 = peace — absence of war/conflict.
平安 = peace / tranquillity — literary; peace of mind; the Heian era.

期間 = a period / term — a span of time (the duration).
時代 = an era / age — a historical period.

警官 = a policeman — the short form.
警察官 = a police officer — the full, formal term.

位置 = position / location — where something physically is.
立場 = position / standpoint — one's situation or viewpoint.

姿勢 = posture / stance — how you hold your body; also an attitude.
格好 = appearance / figure — how something looks.

祈願 = a prayer / supplication — praying for something (formal, at a shrine).
願い事 = a wish — what you wish for (on a star, at Tanabata).

準備 = preparation — getting ready (the whole process).
用意 = preparation / provision — having things ready to hand.

予防 = prevention — warding off illness/problems beforehand (予防接種 vaccination).
防止 = prevention / checking — stopping something bad (事故防止).

製品 = a manufactured product — made in a factory.
商品 = merchandise / goods — items for sale.

公共 = public / communal — for everyone (公共交通機関).
公設 = publicly established — set up by the state.

紫 = purple (the colour).
紫色 = purple colour — the 色 makes it explicit.

割合 = ratio / proportion (everyday).
比率 = ratio / rate — formal, mathematical.

本当に = really / truly — genuinely.
果たして = sure enough / really? — literary: 'as expected', or 'I wonder if really'.

領収書 = a receipt — official, for expenses/tax.
受領書 = an acknowledgement of receipt — confirming something was received/delivered.

返事 = a reply / answer — spoken or written (everyday).
返信 = a reply in writing — to a letter, message, email.

お願い = a request / favour — 'please, would you…'.
注文 = an order — placing an order for goods or food.

住む = to live / reside (everyday).
在留する = to reside in a country — formal, legal (visa status).

住宅 = a dwelling / housing — a house, residential property.
在留 = residence / stay — in a country, legal status.

休み = a rest / break / day off (noun).
休む = to rest / take time off (verb).

田んぼ = a rice paddy (everyday).
田 = a rice field — formal and in compounds (田植え).

役割 = a role / part — the function one plays.
役 = a role — a part in a play; also an official post (役に立つ 'be useful').

部屋 = a room (everyday).
〜室 = -room (suffix: 会議室 meeting room, 教室 classroom).

回る = to turn / go around — intransitive (it spins, you go round).
回転する = to rotate / revolve — formal, mechanical.

営む = to run / conduct — a business or a life (formal, 'carry on').
営業する = to operate / do business / be open — sales, trading hours.

席 = a seat / place (everyday).
座席 = a seat — formal, a fixed/numbered seat (座席番号).

送る = to send — mail, or see a person off.
帰す = to send (someone) back / home.

本気 = serious / in earnest — not joking, 'for real' (about intent).
大変 = serious / terrible / tough — a big deal, hard going (about a situation).
真面目 = serious / earnest / diligent — describes character: sincere, hardworking, no-nonsense.

形 = shape / form.
格好 = shape / appearance / figure — how it looks; also 'good-looking, stylish'.

光る = to shine / glow / glitter — emit light.
差す = (light) to shine in / stream in; also 'to hold up' (an umbrella).

短い = short — in length or duration.
低い = low / short — in height (a short person, a low wall).

観光 = sightseeing / tourism — touring as a tourist.
見物 = sightseeing / watching — going to see a spectacle (花火見物).

煙 = smoke (noun).
吸う = to smoke / inhale (verb — also breathe in, suck).

社会 = society — the social world (formal).
世の中 = society / the world — everyday 'the way of the world'.

音 = a sound (noun).
鳴る = to sound / ring (verb — a bell, a phone sounds).

専門 = a speciality / field of expertise — your professional field.
特技 = a special skill / party trick — something you're personally good at.

立派 = splendid / fine / respectable — impressive, admirable.
見事 = splendid / magnificent — a brilliant feat, beautifully done.

刺す = to stab / pierce / prick — a knife, a needle, a bee.
突く = to thrust / poke / jab — push at, prod.

株 = a share / stock (also a tree stump).
株式 = stock / shares — formal (株式会社, the share system).

強い = strong (general).
強力 = powerful / forceful — potent, high-powered (強力なエンジン).

引き算 = subtraction — everyday, school maths.
減法 = subtraction — the formal mathematical term.

成功 = success — achieving a goal.
当たり = a hit / a win — a lucky strike, a winner (大当たり).

突然 = suddenly / abruptly — out of nowhere.
急に = suddenly / all at once — an abrupt change.

自殺 = suicide — the common word.
自決 = self-determination; also suicide — formal/dated, an 'honourable' end.

制度 = a system / institution — a social or organisational system (教育制度).
仕組み = a structure / mechanism — how something is set up and works.

尻尾 = a tail (everyday).
尾 = tail — literary and in compounds (尾を引く 'leave a lingering effect').

用事 = an errand / thing to do — something to attend to.
用 = business / a matter — 用がある 'I have something to do'.

先生 = teacher — also a title for doctors etc., and used to address them.
教師 = a teacher — the profession (formal).

技術 = technique / technology — skill and know-how broadly.
技 = a technique / move — a specific skill (a wrestling move, a craft).

万 = ten thousand — the unit.
一万 = ten thousand — '1 × 万' (10,000).

有り難う = thank you — spoken thanks.
お礼 = thanks / gratitude — an act of thanking or a token (お礼をする, a thank-you gift).

物 = a thing — a physical object.
事 = a thing / matter — an intangible (an event, a fact, an affair).

今回 = this time / this occasion — this particular instance.
今度 = this time; also 'next time / soon' — context decides.

時間 = time / a duration / an hour — an amount of time.
時 = time / a point in time — 'when' (子供の時).

〜回 = -times — number of occurrences (3回 three times).
〜倍 = -fold / times — a multiplier (3倍 three times as much).

観光客 = a tourist — a sightseer.
旅行者 = a traveller — someone on a trip.

三角 = a triangle / triangular (everyday).
三角形 = a triangle — the geometric shape (formal).

真実 = the truth — the real facts.
実 = truth / reality (also 'fruit') — literary; 実は 'actually, the truth is'.

地下 = underground — below ground (basement, subway).
地中 = in the ground / subterranean — buried in the earth.

不明 = unknown / unclear — not known (原因不明 cause unknown).
不詳 = unknown / unspecified — details not on record (身元不詳).

使う = to use — everyday verb.
使用 = use / usage — formal noun (使用禁止 'no use permitted').

価値 = value / worth — how valuable something is.
値 = a value / figure — a numerical value or price.

色々 = various / all sorts — everyday.
様々 = various / diverse — more formal / written.

待合室 = a waiting room — the room itself.
待合 = a waiting area / meeting place — also an old word for a teahouse.

起きる = to wake up / get up — also 'to occur'.
目覚める = to awaken — eyes opening; also a figurative awakening.

注意 = caution / a warning — 'watch out, pay attention' (everyday).
警告 = a formal warning — stern and official (警告を受ける).

俺たち = we — rough, masculine.
俺ら = we — rough, masculine, even more casual/regional.

武器 = a weapon (general; also figurative 'an asset').
兵器 = military weaponry / arms — large-scale (核兵器 nuclear weapons).

狼男 = a werewolf — literally 'wolf-man'.
人狼 = a werewolf — literally 'man-wolf'; also the party game 'Werewolf'.

西 = west — the direction.
西洋 = the West / the Occident — the Western world and culture.

白 = white — the noun / the colour.
白い = white — the い-adjective ('a white …').

望み = a wish / hope / desire (noun).
望む = to wish for / desire (verb).

女 = woman / female — plain, can be blunt.
女の人 = a woman — polite ('a female person').

言葉 = word / language / speech — broadly 'words'.
単語 = a vocabulary word — a single lexical item.

働く = to work (verb) — labour, hold a job.
作業 = work / operations (noun) — a task, manual or routine work.

世界 = the world — the globe, everyone.
世 = the world / society / an era — literary (世の中, この世).

文章 = writing / prose — sentences, a composition.
文 = a sentence; also 'writing' (literary).

君 = you — familiar and soft (to a junior or peer; can be affectionate).
お前 = you — rough, very casual (close friends, or confrontational).

青春 = youth — the springtime of life, one's youthful days.
青年 = a youth — a young person (esp. a young man).

一位 = first place / first rank (general).
第一位 = the first place — formal/emphatic ('the No.1 spot').
首位 = the top spot / the lead — standings, rankings, sales (首位を走る).

指差す = to point at with a finger (physically point).
指す = to point to / indicate; also 'to head toward' and 'to move/play' (a shogi piece).

上げる = to raise / lift / give (raise something's height; give to someone; raise a level).
挙げる = to raise a hand (volunteer), cite/give (an example), or hold a ceremony (式を挙げる).

見せる = to show / let someone see (display, present).
現す = to reveal / manifest — show one's true nature, or an effect appears (効果を現す).

直線 = a straight line (geometry; a drawn line).
一文字 = in a straight line — like the character 一 (一文字に, 'straight across / in a row').

太陽 = the sun — the celestial body/star.
日 = sun / sunlight / day — 日が昇る (the sun rises); also 'day' more broadly.

容疑 = suspicion of a crime — 容疑者 = a suspect (police context).
嫌疑 = suspicion / being under suspicion — formal, the doubt or charge itself (嫌疑をかける).

閉める = to close something (transitive) — doors, windows, drawers, a shop.
閉まる = (something) closes by itself (intransitive) — the door closes; the pair of 閉める.
閉じる = to close / shut — things that fold or come together: a book, your eyes, an umbrella, a meeting or an era. Works as both transitive and intransitive.

協会 = an association / society — a formal organisation or governing body (日本〜協会).
付き合い = association / socialising — keeping company, social ties, going out with someone.

果物 = fruit — the everyday food you eat (apples, oranges); the common/culinary word.
果実 = fruit — botanical or formal; the fruit of a plant, also figurative (努力の果実 = the fruits of one's efforts).

支払い = payment — the general act of paying (a bill, wages, a fee); everyday word.
決済 = settlement / payment — clearing or settling a transaction; business/finance term.

繋がる = to be connected / linked — a physical or literal connection: wires, roads, a phone line, being related (電話が繋がる).
結び付く = to become tied together — an abstract or causal link forming between things: evidence linking to a conclusion, effort leading to a result (努力が成功に結び付く).

効果 = effect / effectiveness — the desired result something produces; how well it works (効果がある = it's effective).
作用 = action / effect — the technical, scientific sense of one thing acting on another (副作用 = side effect; 化学作用 = chemical action).

天気 = weather — the everyday word for today's conditions (天気がいい, 天気予報 = weather forecast).
天候 = weather conditions — the state of the weather over a longer stretch of time; formal/meteorological (悪天候 = bad weather, 天候不順 = unsettled weather).

絶対 = absolutely / definitely — certainty or a flat refusal; often with a negative (絶対に無理 = absolutely impossible, 絶対に行かない = I'm definitely not going).
是非 = by all means / definitely — eager encouragement attached to a request or invitation (是非来てください = please do come, 是非やりたい = I'd really love to do it). Never used for refusals.

巻く = to roll up / wind — wrapping something around itself or another object: a scarf, bandage, tape, sushi (マフラーを巻く).
転がす = to roll something along — making an object travel over a surface: a ball, a barrel, a stone (ボールを転がす).

場面 = a scene — a moment in a story, film or play; also a situation you find yourself in (感動的な場面 = a moving scene).
光景 = a sight / spectacle — a striking or memorable scene you witness with your own eyes (信じられない光景 = an unbelievable sight).

反響 = an echo / reverberation (noun) — sound bouncing back; also figurative: the public reaction to something (大きな反響を呼ぶ = to provoke a big response).
響く = to echo / resound (verb) — the act of a sound carrying and reverberating (鐘の音が響く).
山びこ = a mountain echo — your voice coming back at you in the hills; the specific natural phenomenon.

新鮮 = fresh — not stale; food, air, or a new perspective (新鮮な魚, 新鮮な空気, 新鮮な発想).
生 = raw / unprocessed — uncooked or untreated rather than 'fresh': 生野菜 (raw vegetables), 生ビール (draft beer), 生放送 (live broadcast).

影響 = influence / effect — the impact one thing has on another; the everyday word (影響を受ける = to be influenced).
勢力 = influence / power — the sphere of power a group, nation or force commands; political, military or natural (勢力を拡大する, 台風の勢力).

限界 = the limit / boundary (noun) — the furthest point something can reach (限界を超える = to exceed one's limits).
限る = to limit / be limited to (verb) — restricting something to a set scope (参加は10人に限る = participation is limited to 10 people).
限定 = limited / exclusive — a deliberately restricted release or scope (期間限定 = limited-time, 100個限定 = limited to 100 units).

居る = to be / to be present — everyday word for living things being somewhere (猫が居る). Usually written in kana as いる; the kanji 居る is the same word.
存在する = to exist — abstract or formal existence, whether something is real at all (神は存在するのか, 問題が存在する). Not used for simply being in a place.

歴史 = history — the study of the past, or the past of a country or thing (日本の歴史, 歴史を学ぶ).
履歴 = a record / log — the trail of what someone or something has done: CV, browsing history (履歴書 = résumé, 検索履歴 = search history).

給料 = salary / pay — the everyday word for the money you earn from your job (給料日 = payday).
給与 = compensation / remuneration — the formal, administrative term covering pay and benefits; used in contracts and payroll (給与明細 = pay statement).

状況 = the situation / circumstances — the objective state of affairs around an event, often changing (状況が変わる, 現在の状況).
様子 = the look of things / appearance — how something seems from observing it; also a person's manner (様子を見る = to wait and see, 心配そうな様子).

届ける = to deliver / take something to someone — the general act of getting a thing to a person, by anyone (忘れ物を届ける = to take a lost item to its owner). Also 'to report / notify' officially (警察に届ける). Its intransitive pair is 届く (to arrive / be delivered).
配達する = to deliver — commercial or postal delivery as a service: mail, parcels, newspapers, food (郵便を配達する, ピザを配達する).

触る = to touch — deliberately putting your hand on something (作品に触らないでください = please don't touch the exhibits). Physical only.
触れる = to touch / come into contact — lighter or more incidental contact, and the word used figuratively: to touch on a subject (問題に触れる), to be exposed to something (異文化に触れる).
感触 = the feel / sensation (noun) — the texture or impression something gives when touched (柔らかい感触); also a gut feeling about how something is going.

岩 = a rock / boulder — one specific large rock you can see, touch or climb (大きな岩, 岩に登る).
岩石 = rock as a material — the geological substance itself; scientific and technical register (岩石の種類 = types of rock, 火成岩).

岸 = the bank / shore — the edge where land meets water, river or sea (向こう岸 = the opposite bank, 川岸).
岸辺 = the waterside / shoreline — the strip of land running along the water rather than the boundary itself; softer and more literary (岸辺を歩く = to walk along the shore).
